milestones.title: Red Hat build fix release for CVE-2026-6856 confirmed and recorded, or the Red Hat build ruled out for hosted sites

remediation: Hosted sites run upstream Keycloak at or above the minimum version in the hosted verification records. Before a site runs the Red Hat build of Keycloak instead, confirm with Red Hat which release of that build fixes CVE-2026-6856 for the release line the site would run (Red Hat's data names 26.4.12 and still lists the build as affected; Bugzilla 2460004 reads NEW), and record the answer with its source and date in the hosted verification records.
title: The Red Hat build of Keycloak release that fixes CVE-2026-6856 is not confirmed
